appDesc.message: Reads the article behind a link and shows an honest title, summary, and clickbait score — before you click.

optStoredHint.message: Your API key is stored in chrome.storage.sync and only sent to the selected provider.

optLanguageHint.message: (title & summary; blank = auto, match the article)

optLimitsHint.message: Preview fetches + summarizes a link before you click. These caps stop bursty hovering from blowing your provider quota.

tipThrottled.message: slow down — hover one link at a time. Try again in a moment.

tipRateLimited.message: rate limited by provider. Cooling down ~$SECS$s (hover again later).

tipCapped.message: daily preview limit reached ($USED$/$CAP$). Raise it in Options.

errNoKey.message: No API key set for "$PROVIDER$". Open Options and paste your key.

optInstructionsHint.message: (optional — appended to the prompt; the JSON output shape is kept)

optUiLanguageHint.message: (the extension's buttons & labels; Auto = follow your browser)

optReport.message: Questions or problems? Email the author:

connectionTestHint.message: Tests the current provider, model and key without saving. Makes one small generation request; quota or usage charges may apply. No article content is sent.

connectionSuccess.message: Connection successful. The selected provider and model returned text.

connectionMissingKey.message: Enter an API key first. Local Ollama does not require one.

connectionSettings.message: Check the provider, model and API base URL. Use an HTTP or HTTPS base URL without embedded credentials, query parameters or fragments.

connectionAuth.message: Authentication failed (401). Check that this key belongs to the selected provider and has not been revoked.

connectionAccess.message: Access denied (403). Check key permissions, account restrictions and access to this model.

connectionQuota.message: Quota or rate limit reached (429). Check billing credits and provider limits; this does not necessarily mean the key is invalid.

connectionModel.message: Model or endpoint not found (404). Check the model name and API base URL.

connectionHttp.message: The provider returned HTTP $STATUS$. Check its service status and your settings.

connectionResponse.message: The endpoint returned an unexpected response. Check that the API base URL matches this provider’s API format.

connectionEmpty.message: The model returned no readable text. Check model compatibility or try another model.

connectionTimeout.message: The connection test timed out. Try again later or check that your local model is running.

connectionNetwork.message: Could not reach the endpoint. Check the API base URL, network connection and browser site permissions.

connectionBusy.message: A connection test is already running. Please wait and try again.

connectionDenied.message: Connection tests can only be started from this extension’s Settings page.

connectionBudget.message: The endpoint responded, but the test output budget was exhausted before readable text appeared. This does not establish an invalid key; try a non-thinking model or check its thinking settings.

linkInvalid.message: Link previews support only HTTP and HTTPS links.

linkRateLimited.message: The provider is rate limiting requests. Wait about $SECS$ seconds, then right-click the link and try again.

linkThrottled.message: Another preview is running or requests are too close together. Wait a moment, then right-click the link and try again.

popupHintLinks.message: Preview a link: hold Alt and hover, or right-click → debait this link.

popupHintSetup.message: First use? Set your provider and API key (if needed) in Settings below.
